# Tiktok

TikTok short-form video platform + creation tools + social sharing

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tiktok/.

## Actions

- **Post photo**: Create a photo post via content posting api (direct post or media upload).
- **Publish video**: Finalize and publish a video from the inbox using its publish id.
- **Upload video**: Uploads a video to tiktok via the content posting api (init + single-part upload).
- **Upload videos (batch)**: Uploads multiple videos to tiktok concurrently (init + single-part upload per file).
- **Fetch publish status** (read-only): Fetch current publish/upload status for a given publish id.
- **Get user basic info** (read-only): Fetches basic tiktok user info for the authenticated user.
- **Get user profile info** (read-only): Fetches extended tiktok profile info for the authenticated user.
- **Get user stats** (read-only): Fetches tiktok user stats for the authenticated user.
- **List videos** (read-only): Lists videos for the authenticated user (or specified creator).
